title: Fresh-Zone Cleanup — delete dead entity-recycling layer
why: Every zone transition (new game, death-retry, advance, continue, post-reboot load) already rebuilds zone content fresh via instantiateZone from layout+seed. The restoreArea/rememberInitial/_initPos recycling machinery underneath is a production no-op that misleads debugging (it cost a full investigation during the ghost-hero bug) and adds ~150 lines of reset code for a bug class that fresh-build eliminates.
outcomes: restoreArea + 4 restore fns + rememberInitial + _initPos writes deleted; enterZone becomes the single owner of fresh zone install; preserved state (energy/coins/lives/run) provably untouched; test suite green with zero behavior change

milestones.name: Evidence
milestones.objective: Prove restoreArea is a production no-op before deleting anything.
milestones.success: Logged evidence shows restore fns never fire in any real transition; baseline test suite green.
milestones.diagram:
flowchart LR
    A[Playtest death-retry advance continue reboot-load] --> B[restore fns log calls]
    B --> C{Any call with live _initPos?}
    C -->|no| D[Confirmed dead - proceed]
    C -->|yes| E[Stop - investigate caller]

tasks.name: Instrument restore fns + baseline suite
tasks.what: Add a one-line console.warn at the top of restoreEnemy/restoreBarrel/restorePowerup/restoreCheckpoint in lifecycle.js that fires only when _initPos is present (i.e. a real restore would happen). Run full test suite as baseline.
tasks.why: Deletion must be evidence-backed: if any production path actually restores, we stop and investigate instead of deleting live code.
acceptance: Baseline: node --test over js/test/*.test.js all green, count recorded
Instrumentation compiles clean, no test behavior change
verify: cd petal-panic && for f in js/test/*.test.js; do node --test $f >/dev/null || echo FAIL $f; done

tasks.name: Playtest evidence pass
tasks.what: In the browser: new game, die once (retry), advance an area, save-quit, reload page and Continue. Watch console for [evidence] lines.
tasks.why: Tests exercise restoreArea directly with hand-built _initPos; only a real playthrough proves no production transition reaches it with live snapshots.
acceptance: Zero [evidence] lines across death-retry, advance, in-session continue, post-reboot continue
Game plays normally through all four transitions (sanity: fresh-build paths unaffected)

milestones.name: Consolidate zone install
milestones.objective: Make enterZone the one place that installs fresh zone content, in the pinned order: transients cleared -> fresh zone installed -> run/life rules -> hero placed.
milestones.success: Death/retry/continue no longer call resetActiveZoneContent separately; enterZone does it via the transition rule; behavior identical.
milestones.diagram:
flowchart TD
    A[transition name] --> B[enterZone]
    B --> C[run rule: fresh rollback refill restore keep]
    B --> D[life rule: reset refill keep fresh]
    B --> E{rule rebuilds zone?}
    E -->|death-retry continue save-load| F[clearTransientWorld + instantiateZone fresh]
    E -->|advance new-game| G[zone already fresh-installed by caller]
    F --> H[placeHeroAtEntry + resetHitstop + showAreaEntry]

tasks.name: enterZone owns fresh zone install
tasks.what: Move the resetActiveZoneContent logic (transient teardown + instantiateZone reinstall, incl. boss-zone branch) into enterZone, gated by a new rule field (e.g. zone: 'rebuild') on death-retry/continue/save-load transitions. Callers (finishHeroDeath path, retryLevel, continueFromGameOver) drop their separate resetActiveZoneContent calls.
tasks.why: Two owners of 'install zone content' is how the dead layer survived; one owner keyed by transition rule makes the fresh-build contract explicit and testable.
acceptance: Death -> retry: zone entities are fresh objects (new references), hero placed at entry, lives decremented once
Continue (in-session): same rebuild, lives refilled, area back to level's area 1
Pinned order preserved: transients cleared before install, install before hero placement
verify: cd petal-panic && node --test js/test/levelFlow.test.js js/test/menuRunFlow.test.js js/test/lifecycle.test.js

tasks.name: Regression: preserved state across transitions
tasks.what: Add a test asserting the hero/run objects SURVIVE death-retry and continue by reference (same instance), while zone entities are replaced (different references), and energy/coins/lives follow the per-transition rules.
tasks.why: This is the user's core concern - the cleanup must provably not touch preserved state; pin it as a regression net before deletion.
acceptance: Hero and run object identity stable across death-retry/continue
Zone entity references differ after rebuild transitions
Wallet rollback / life refill values match TRANSITIONS rules

milestones.name: Delete dead layer
milestones.objective: Remove the recycling machinery now that enterZone is the single owner and evidence confirms it was a no-op.
milestones.success: restoreArea + restore fns + rememberInitial + _initPos gone from production code; suite green; playtest clean.
milestones.diagram:
flowchart LR
    A[rm restoreArea + 4 restore fns] --> B[rm rememberInitial + _initPos writes]
    B --> C[rm instrumentation from M1]
    C --> D[rewrite tests to enterZone contract]
    D --> E[full suite + playtest]

tasks.name: Delete restore machinery + _initPos
tasks.what: Remove from lifecycle.js: restoreArea, restoreEnemy, restoreBarrel, restorePowerup, restoreCheckpoint, rememberInitial, resetGeneration's entity loops, and the enterZone restoreArea call site. Remove rememberInitial calls in update.js (zone install + boss) and debugHarness.js; remove M1 instrumentation.
tasks.why: The layer is proven dead and its presence misleads future debugging (it cost the ghost-hero investigation real time).
acceptance: grep for restoreArea|rememberInitial|_initPos in js/ (non-test) returns zero hits
No production behavior change: full suite green except tests rewritten in 3.2
verify: cd petal-panic && grep -rn 'restoreArea\|rememberInitial\|_initPos' js --include=*.js | grep -v test

tasks.name: Rewrite restore-era tests to fresh-build contract
tasks.what: Update the ~6 test files referencing restoreArea/rememberInitial (lifecycle, levelFlow, menuRunFlow, screens, populate, reward) to assert the fresh-build contract instead: transitions produce fresh entity references from layout+seed, deterministic per seed.
tasks.why: Tests currently pin the dead API; they must pin the real contract or the suite breaks and future regressions hide behind stale assertions.
acceptance: Full node --test suite green across all 133 test files
verify: cd petal-panic && for f in js/test/*.test.js; do node --test $f >/dev/null || echo FAIL $f; done

tasks.name: Update lifecycle docs + final playtest
tasks.what: Rewrite the restore sections of docs/levels/lifecycle.md §3 (and any state-persistence.md references) to state the fresh-build contract: every zone entry installs content via instantiateZone from layout+seed; liveness flags are one-directional. Final browser playtest: new game, death-retry, advance, save-quit, reboot continue.
tasks.why: The docs currently describe the deleted recycling model; stale docs are how dead code gets resurrected.
acceptance: Docs describe fresh-build as the only zone-entry mechanism
Final playtest clean through all five transitions, no console errors
